title: Gupta religion: more sects, texts, temples

boxes.title: Vaishnavism: added detail
items: Heliodorus at court of Sunga ==**Bhagabhadra**==; at **Vidisha**; called himself a Bhagavata
Vasudeva called **Devadevas**; **Panini** refers to Vasudeva worship
Guptas contributed most to the sect (BPSC **1994**); **Skandagupta**: Garuda on coins
Udayagiri cave = CG II's **personal temple**; Varaha = rescue from **Sakas**

boxes.title: Puranas & worship: more
items: Principal: **Vishnu, Bhagavata, Matsya, Vayu, Brahmanda, Markandeya, Shiva, Kurma**
==**Pancha-lakshana**==: creation, re-creation, genealogies, manvantaras, dynastic history
**Smarta** practices spread; six schools took final shape
**Ardhanarishvara**: Shiva + Parvati; **Durga, Amba, Kali, Chandi**; **Gaja-Lakshmi** on seals

boxes.title: Buddhism & Jainism: more
items: Asanga, Vasubandhu **4th c.**; Dinnaga, Buddhaghosa **5th c.** (Pali, Theravada)
Udayagiri: ==**1 Jain cave** of **20**==; **Vidisha**: Ramagupta's Jain images
Fa-Hien mentions Jainism; **Hiuen Tsang** does not

cards.title: AP angle
lines: **Nandivarman II**: ==**Pedavegi**== = first AP record on Vishnu temples
